creator: Alexander Terp
description:
When a devenv tunnel is reopened, the bridges started while it was down fail, and nothing asks for them again when the tunnel is back. They wait for the watchdog's `bridge.stalled`, which came 15s after the drop and 14s after the tunnel was usable.

Measured 2026-09-28 at 22:25:50Z (0.11.0, Alex's Mac, window 98894), after the drop in a_2YQCqiInL. The core replaced the four on-screen devenv bridges 80ms after the old ones hung up. The tunnel's local socket did not exist yet, so each new bridge failed to attach.

From `~/Library/Logs/muster/muster-2026-09-28_16-30-31-98894.jsonl`:

    22:25:50.815Z       bridge.stream.lost x7    the daemon hung up
    22:25:50.897-.904Z  bridge.attach.failed x4  could not connect to .../muster-98894-devenv.sock: No such file or directory
    22:25:51.587Z       backend.reconnected      devenv
    22:25:52.313Z       tunnel.reverse
    22:25:55.819Z       problem.raised x4        lost the connection carrying it and has not got one back within 5s
    22:26:05.820Z       bridge.stalled x4        quiet_for_ms=5000 restarts=2
    22:26:05.935-.950Z  problem.cleared x4       pane.typeable

The notification raised at 22:25:55 told Alex to check that the machine was reachable, 4s after it was reachable again. Asking again for a bridge for every pane on that daemon with none live, on `backend.reconnected` or `tunnel.reopened`, would have brought these panes back at about 22:25:52 and raised nothing. `session::reattach` in `crates/muster-seam/src/session.rs` already does this for one pane when a person asks.
title: 🐢 A bridge that fails during a reconnect waits 15s for the watchdog, not for the tunnel
